<bookmark mark='pair'/>That order pairs B with B, so it claims eigh B equals C B.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The letters must follow the equal angles, so we must check them first.

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>The opposite sides of a parallelogram are equal.
<bookmark mark='two'/>When you match triangles, let the equal angles decide the order of letters.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. In parallelogram eigh B C D, eigh B is three centimetres and eigh D is seven. Find C B and C D.
